description: The DE pack can be extended with operating-expense accounts without one of its statements losing them. This was a trap and the trap was the finding, not the missing accounts: `de-guv` mapped position 6 by the RANGE 6000–6099, while `de-euer` position A5 listed explicit `numbers: ["6000", "6700"]`. So an account added at 6035 flowed into the income statement correctly and vanished from the EÜR — the same chart, the same posting, two statements disagreeing about whether the money exists, and nothing saying so. A pack whose mappings disagree about how the chart may be extended is a trap for whoever extends it. `de-euer` now maps by range like `de-guv`, carved around the positions that name single accounts because the law does (Bewirtung abziehbar/nicht abziehbar, Restbuchwert bei Anlagenabgang). This fixture pins the property, not the account list: an expense account created after the tenant exists reaches BOTH statements.

expect.comment: An account the shipped chart does not carry, in the band both statements now map by range.
Position 6 by range — this half was always right.

The half that was wrong: before the fix this reported the amount under the account's own name — outside every line of the Anlage EÜR — plus a gap warning. Now it lands in A5 where the income statement already put it, and there is nothing to warn about.
